name: Bakusou Josou Keikaku ~Moshimo Ore ga Josou Saserarete Ladies ni Nyuutai Saseraretara~
original_name: 爆走女装計画～もしも俺が女装させられてレディースに入隊させられたら～
source:
The LuckyBunnies are a tough gang who wear long biker jackets and have a strict no-men policy.
The gang consists of Rika, Satomi and their leader, Mika.
They were once considered the most notorious ladies in the town they called their turf... but time passed, and before they knew it, they were the weakest gang of them all.
In order to restore honor to her gang and make it through this crisis, Mika considers dragging in a friend of hers, somebody known to be the toughest fighter around.
And that person is Mika’s lifelong pal, Tamaki Aizawa.
Mika urges him to become a member of the LuckyBunnies. Tamaki refuses.
When Mika threatens to show everybody the picture they took when they were young of Tamaki in women’s clothing, he reconsiders.
But because of the LuckyBunnies’s strict no-men policy, Mika forces Tamaki once again to don his lady clothes...

And so, the LuckyBunnies take to the streets at night, with their newest member in tow, in order to reclaim their former glory.

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/bakusoujosoukeikaku-ja/]Johren[/url]]
translation:
“幸运兔”是一个身穿长款暴走族特攻服、作风强硬，而且严禁男性加入的不良少女团体。
成员包括莉香、里美，以及首领美香。
她们曾是地盘所在城镇里恶名最盛的不良少女……然而时光流逝，等众人回过神来，“幸运兔”已经沦为实力最弱的团体。
为了挽回名誉、挺过危机，美香考虑拉一个朋友入伙；那个人素有周围最强打手之名。
他就是美香从小到大的伙伴相泽环。
美香劝环加入“幸运兔”，环却一口拒绝。
美香威胁要把两人小时候拍下的那张环穿女装的照片公之于众，他只好重新考虑。
然而，“幸运兔”有着严禁男性加入的铁律，于是美香强迫环再次穿上女装……

就这样，“幸运兔”带着最新成员在夜晚驶上街头，准备夺回昔日荣光。
